tau_single_point_failure §7 extensions (also §1 introduction, §8 conclusions) +

A high-tau (~0.09) universe and a high-A_lens universe are partially degenerate through A_s exp(-2tau); both reduce the apparent w0wa preference by a similar factor (~2x). A Planck low-l tau systematic would be a single-point failure for every CMB-based cosmological analysis.

Defined in

extensions.tex:32

Evidence

  • ev_sailer_2025: Sailer+25 (arXiv:2504.16932): tau=0.090+/-0.012 from CMB+lensing+DESI within LambdaCDM, ~3-5 sigma above Planck low-l. Empirical degeneracy Omega_m(tau) ~ 0.349 - 0.505 tau.
    Reference: arXiv:2504.16932
  • ev_ext_c0_table: Our Table 12: A_lens reduces BAO c0 tension from 2.2 sigma to 1.1 sigma.
    Code: compute_paper_numbers.py

Depends on: alens_dilutes
